title: Diversity in Gaming: An Analysis of Video Game Characters
author: Brittney Lin
limitations: Selected major releases, not a random sample or a current industry census.
Games with only fully customizable characters were excluded.
The 5.8% category combines non-binary characters and undocumented gender; it cannot estimate either group separately.
Ethnicity covers only human or human-like characters; its subsample size is not stated.
All other ethnicities combined hides differences between groups.
The study's categories are reported as published, not proposed as an identity taxonomy.
